final: WITH side_counts AS (SELECT o.dealedge AS side, COUNT(*) AS match_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault COLLATE BINARY = r.ordervault COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY o.dealedge), overall AS (SELECT AVG(match_count) AS average_count FROM side_counts) SELECT SUM(s.match_count) AS total_count, AVG(s.match_count - a.average_count) AS average_excess FROM side_counts AS s JOIN overall AS a ON a.average_count IS NOT NULL WHERE s.match_count > a.average_count
